qualification: PROVISIONAL N08 compute-only speed diagnostic; the measured curve must pass EGO's per-axis feasibility bound and a 0.15 m/s derivative-control-point norm bound. This is not braking qualification or XY authorization.
rationale: Only max_velocity_m_s changes from the #225 N08 profile. EGO feasibility is checked per axis with a 5% tolerance; 0.075 m/s yields a nominal component threshold of 0.07875 m/s, whose three-axis Euclidean norm is below 0.15 m/s if the observed spline satisfies feasibility. The live spline derivative certificate remains authoritative. The 0.25 m/s2 planner acceleration parameter is not treated as PX4 deceleration. N05/N06 body radius, map freshness and terminal-hold rules are unchanged. Compute-only bridge isolation is mandatory.
